entries.title: Dwyer McAllister Cottage
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa rural restaurada aos pés da montanha Keadeen, palco de um episódio da Rebelião de 1798 e hoje pequeno museu de época.
entries.en_excerpt: Restored farmhouse at the foot of Keadeen mountain, scene of an episode of the 1798 Rebellion and today a small period museum.

entries.title: National Botanic Garden of Ireland – Kilmacurragh
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardim botânico no condado de Wicklow, parte dos Jardins Botânicos Nacionais, famoso pelos rododendros e pelas árvores raras numa antiga propriedade do século XIX.
entries.en_excerpt: Botanic garden in County Wicklow, part of the National Botanic Gardens, famous for its rhododendrons and rare trees on a former 19th-century estate.

entries.title: Fore Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Ruínas do mosteiro fundado por São Feichin no século VII, num vale tranquilo do condado de Westmeath, com as lendárias “Sete Maravilhas de Fore”.
entries.en_excerpt: Ruins of the monastery founded by St Feichin in the 7th century, in a tranquil valley in County Westmeath, with the legendary "Seven Wonders of Fore".

entries.title: Roscrea Castle, Gardens and Damer House/Black Mills
entries.pt_excerpt: Conjunto no centro de Roscrea com um castelo do século XIII, a casa pré-paladiana Damer House e jardins murados com fonte.
entries.en_excerpt: A group of buildings in the centre of Roscrea with a 13th-century castle, the pre-Palladian Damer House and walled gardens with a fountain.

entries.title: The Main Guard
entries.pt_excerpt: Antigo tribunal do século XVII no centro de Clonmel, com arcada de colunas de arenito restaurada e espaço de exposições.
entries.en_excerpt: A former 17th-century courthouse in the centre of Clonmel, with a restored sandstone columned arcade and an exhibition space.

entries.title: Famine Warhouse 1848
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa de lavoura perto de Ballingarry que foi palco de um cerco sangrento da Rebelião dos Jovens Irlandeses de 1848, hoje museu.
entries.en_excerpt: A farmhouse near Ballingarry that was the scene of a bloody siege during the 1848 Young Ireland Rebellion, now a museum.

entries.title: St. Mary’s Church Gowran
entries.pt_excerpt: Igreja colegiada do final do século XIII, com túmulos medievais dos Butler e esculturas do “Mestre de Gowran”, hoje monumento nacional.
entries.en_excerpt: A collegiate church from the late 13th century, with medieval Butler tombs and carvings by the "Gowran Master", now a national monument.

entries.title: Kells Priory
entries.pt_excerpt: O maior recinto eclesiástico murado da Irlanda, fundado por volta de 1193 e conhecido localmente como os “Sete Castelos de Kells”.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's largest walled ecclesiastical enclosure, founded around 1193 and known locally as the "Seven Castles of Kells".

entries.title: Dungarvan Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo anglo-normando de cerca de 1209 que protegia a entrada do porto de Dungarvan, com um raro “shell keep” poligonal.
entries.en_excerpt: An Anglo-Norman castle of about 1209 that guarded the entrance to Dungarvan harbour, with a rare polygonal shell keep.

entries.title: Newmills Corn and Flax Mills
entries.pt_excerpt: Conjunto industrial do século XIX perto de Letterkenny, com uma das maiores rodas de água em funcionamento do país, que servia a indústria do linho.
entries.en_excerpt: A 19th-century industrial complex near Letterkenny, with one of the largest working waterwheels in the country, which once served the linen industry.

entries.title: Glebe Gallery and Garden – Derek Hill House
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa regencial de 1828 perto de Letterkenny onde viveu o pintor Derek Hill, com uma coleção de arte que inclui Picasso, Renoir e Braque.
entries.en_excerpt: An 1828 Regency house near Letterkenny where the painter Derek Hill lived, with an art collection that includes Picasso, Renoir and Braque.

entries.title: Doe Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Fortaleza medieval dos séculos XV/XVI à beira-mar em Sheephaven Bay, antiga casa dos chefes MacSweeney; terrenos abertos todo o ano.
entries.en_excerpt: A 15th/16th-century fortress by the sea on Sheephaven Bay, former seat of the MacSweeney chiefs; grounds open all year round.

entries.title: Ballyhack Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa-torre de cerca de 1450 sobre o estuário de Waterford, provavelmente construída pelos Cavaleiros Hospitalários de São João.
entries.en_excerpt: A tower house of around 1450 above the Waterford estuary, probably built by the Knights Hospitallers of St John.

entries.title: Ionad Cultúrtha an Phiarsaigh Conamara- Pearse’s Cottage and Visitor Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro cultural em Ros Muc, no coração da Gaeltacht de Connemara, onde Patrick Pearse construiu a sua casa de verão e que hoje se visita tal como ele a deixou.
entries.en_excerpt: A cultural centre in Ros Muc, in the heart of the Connemara Gaeltacht, where Patrick Pearse built his summer house, visited today just as he left it.

entries.title: Aughnanure Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa-torre tardo-medieval mais bem preservada de Connemara, sobre um afloramento rochoso do rio Drimneen, perto do Lough Corrib.
entries.en_excerpt: The best-preserved late-medieval tower house in Connemara, on a rocky outcrop on the River Drimneen, near Lough Corrib.

entries.title: Athenry Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa-torre do século XIII que guardava um vau estratégico no rio Clareen, no centro de uma das vilas medievais mais bem preservadas da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A 13th-century tower house that guarded a strategic ford on the River Clareen, in the centre of one of Ireland's best-preserved medieval towns.

entries.title: Desmond Castle Newcastlewest
entries.pt_excerpt: Salão de banquetes medieval do século XV no centro de Newcastle West, com galeria de carvalho restaurada; acesso por visita guiada.
entries.en_excerpt: A 15th-century medieval banqueting hall in the centre of Newcastle West, with a restored oak gallery; access by guided tour.

entries.title: Adare Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo medieval fortificado nas margens do rio Maigue, com torre quadrada e fosso, ligado aos condes de Desmond; acesso pelo Adare Heritage Centre.
entries.en_excerpt: A fortified medieval castle on the banks of the River Maigue, with a square tower and moat, linked to the Earls of Desmond; access via the Adare Heritage Centre.

entries.title: Askeaton Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Ruínas de uma fortaleza medieval de 1199 no centro de Askeaton, antiga base dos condes de Desmond — atualmente fechada, apenas vista exterior.
entries.en_excerpt: Ruins of a medieval fortress of 1199 in the centre of Askeaton, former base of the Earls of Desmond — currently closed, exterior viewing only.

entries.title: Ionad an Bhlascaoid – The Blasket Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro de património dedicado à comunidade de língua irlandesa das Ilhas Blasket, com exposições interativas e miradouro sobre o Atlântico.
entries.en_excerpt: A heritage centre dedicated to the Irish-speaking community of the Blasket Islands, with interactive exhibitions and a viewpoint over the Atlantic.

entries.title: Listowel Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo anglo-normando sobre o rio Feale, último reduto dos Fitzmaurice na Guerra dos Nove Anos, com acesso por visita guiada.
entries.en_excerpt: An Anglo-Norman castle above the River Feale, the Fitzmaurices' last stronghold in the Nine Years' War, with access by guided tour.

entries.title: Ardfert Cathedral
entries.pt_excerpt: Conjunto de três igrejas medievais, a mais antiga do século XII, no local do mosteiro fundado por São Brandão, o Navegador.
entries.en_excerpt: A group of three medieval churches, the oldest from the 12th century, on the site of the monastery founded by St Brendan the Navigator.

entries.title: Áras an Uachtaráin
entries.pt_excerpt: Residência oficial do Presidente da Irlanda, no Phoenix Park, com visitas guiadas gratuitas aos sábados, sujeitas ao serviço do Estado.
entries.en_excerpt: The official residence of the President of Ireland, in Phoenix Park, with free guided tours on Saturdays, subject to State business.

entries.title: St Stephen’s Green
entries.pt_excerpt: Um dos parques públicos mais conhecidos da Irlanda, no centro da zona comercial de Dublin, mantido no traçado vitoriano original.
entries.en_excerpt: One of Ireland's best-known public parks, in the heart of Dublin's shopping district, kept to its original Victorian layout.

entries.title: St Audoen’s Church and Visitor Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: A única igreja paroquial medieval que resta em Dublin, dedicada ao bispo de Rouen, com a Capela da Guilda de Santa Ana e o túmulo de Portlester.
entries.en_excerpt: Dublin's only surviving medieval parish church, dedicated to the bishop of Rouen, with the St Anne's Guild Chapel and the Portlester tomb.

entries.title: St. Mary’s Abbey – Chapter House – Cistercian Monastery
entries.pt_excerpt: Restos de um dos maiores e mais importantes mosteiros medievais da Irlanda, com acesso apenas por visita guiada e abertura sazonal.
entries.en_excerpt: Remains of one of the largest and most important medieval monasteries in Ireland, accessible by guided tour only and open seasonally.

entries.title: Royal Hospital Kilmainham
entries.pt_excerpt: Um dos edifícios mais emblemáticos de Dublin e o melhor exemplo irlandês de arquitetura do século XVII, hoje sede do Museu Irlandês de Arte Moderna.
entries.en_excerpt: One of Dublin's most landmark buildings and Ireland's finest example of 17th-century architecture, today home to the Irish Museum of Modern Art.

entries.title: Rathfarnham Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo isabelino do século XVI com quatro torres, remodelado no século XVIII, com retratos de família e exposições culturais.
entries.en_excerpt: A 16th-century Elizabethan castle with four towers, remodelled in the 18th century, with family portraits and cultural exhibitions.

entries.title: Phoenix Park – People’s Flower Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardim de flores vitoriano de 9 hectares dentro do Phoenix Park, com lago ornamental, parque infantil e canteiros sazonais.
entries.en_excerpt: A 9-hectare Victorian flower garden inside Phoenix Park, with an ornamental lake, playground and seasonal flower beds.

entries.title: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre, Ashtown Castle and Biodiversity Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro de visitantes do Phoenix Park ao lado do Castelo de Ashtown, uma casa-torre redescoberta, com jardim murado vitoriano e exposições.
entries.en_excerpt: The Phoenix Park visitor centre beside Ashtown Castle, a rediscovered tower house, with a Victorian walled garden and exhibitions.

entries.title: Pearse Museum – St. Enda’s Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu na casa onde Patrick Pearse viveu e dirigiu a sua escola de ensino em irlandês entre 1910 e 1916, num parque de cerca de 20 hectares.
entries.en_excerpt: A museum in the house where Patrick Pearse lived and ran his Irish-speaking school between 1910 and 1916, set in a park of about 20 hectares.

entries.title: Iveagh Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Conhecidos como o “jardim secreto” de Dublin, com labirinto de teixos, rosário, fontes e cascata, desenhados por Ninian Niven em 1865.
entries.en_excerpt: Known as Dublin's "secret garden", with a yew maze, rosery, fountains and cascade, designed by Ninian Niven in 1865.

entries.title: Irish National War Memorial Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins memoriais em Islandbridge, dedicados aos 49.400 soldados irlandeses mortos na Primeira Guerra Mundial, desenhados por Sir Edwin Lutyens.
entries.en_excerpt: Memorial gardens at Islandbridge, dedicated to the 49,400 Irish soldiers who died in the First World War, designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens.

entries.title: Grangegorman Military Cemetery
entries.pt_excerpt: O maior cemitério militar da Irlanda, aberto em 1876 para pessoal do Império Britânico, com túmulos das duas guerras mundiais.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's largest military cemetery, opened in 1876 for British Empire personnel, with graves from both world wars.

entries.title: Government Buildings
entries.pt_excerpt: Sede de departamentos do Estado irlandês e o último grande edifício público construído pelos britânicos na Irlanda, com visitas guiadas gratuitas aos sábados.
entries.en_excerpt: The seat of Irish government departments and the last major public building constructed by the British in Ireland, with free guided tours on Saturdays.

entries.title: Garden of Remembrance
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardim memorial no centro de Dublin, dedicado a todos os que deram a vida pela liberdade irlandesa, com a escultura dos Filhos de Lir.
entries.en_excerpt: A memorial garden in central Dublin, dedicated to all those who gave their lives for Irish freedom, with the Children of Lir sculpture.

entries.title: Farmleigh House and Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Propriedade eduardiana de 78 acres dentro do Phoenix Park, usada como residência oficial de hóspedes do Estado, com jardins e parque abertos ao público.
entries.en_excerpt: A 78-acre Edwardian estate inside Phoenix Park, used as the State's official guest residence, with gardens and parkland open to the public.

entries.title: Custom House Visitor Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro de visitantes dedicado à história do edifício da Alfândega de Dublin, da autoria de James Gandon, e a mais de 230 anos de história irlandesa.
entries.en_excerpt: A visitor centre dedicated to the history of Dublin's Custom House, designed by James Gandon, and to more than 230 years of Irish history.

entries.title: Casino Marino
entries.pt_excerpt: Pequeno templo de jardim neoclássico do século XVIII, com 16 salas decoradas, considerado uma obra-prima da arquitetura europeia.
entries.en_excerpt: A small 18th-century neoclassical garden temple, with 16 decorated rooms, considered a masterpiece of European architecture.

entries.title: Arbour Hill Cemetery
entries.pt_excerpt: Cemitério militar onde estão sepultados 14 dos líderes executados do Levante da Páscoa de 1916.
entries.en_excerpt: A military cemetery where 14 of the executed leaders of the 1916 Easter Rising are buried.

entries.title: Fota Arboretum and Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Arboreto de 11 hectares na Ilha de Fota com uma das melhores coleções da Europa de árvores e arbustos raros ao ar livre.
entries.en_excerpt: An 11-hectare arboretum on Fota Island with one of Europe's finest outdoor collections of rare trees and shrubs.

entries.title: Desmond Castle Kinsale
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa-torre urbana do início do século XVI no centro de Kinsale, que foi alfândega, prisão e armazém ao longo da sua história.
entries.en_excerpt: An urban tower house from the early 16th century in the centre of Kinsale, which over its history served as custom house, prison and warehouse.

entries.title: Barryscourt Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Um dos melhores exemplos de casa-torre irlandesa, construído entre 1392 e 1420, com salões restaurados e jardim de ervas.
entries.en_excerpt: One of the finest examples of an Irish tower house, built between 1392 and 1420, with restored halls and a herb garden.

entries.title: Annes Grove Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Antiga propriedade da família Annesley no norte de Cork, com jardins paisagísticos de estilo Robinsoniano e uma coleção rara de arbustos floridos.
entries.en_excerpt: A former Annesley family estate in north Cork, with Robinsonian-style landscaped gardens and a rare collection of flowering shrubs.

entries.title: National Design & Craft Gallery
entries.pt_excerpt: Única galeria da Irlanda dedicada exclusivamente a design e artesanato, no Castle Yard do século XVIII, ao lado do Kilkenny Castle.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's only gallery dedicated exclusively to design and craft, in the 18th-century Castle Yard, beside Kilkenny Castle.

entries.title: Cavan Cathedral
entries.pt_excerpt: Catedral católica de Cavan, dedicada a São Patrício e São Félim, construída na década de 1940 e notável pelo interior com vitrais.
entries.en_excerpt: Cavan's Catholic cathedral, dedicated to St Patrick and St Felim, built in the 1940s and notable for its stained-glass interior.

entries.title: The John F. Kennedy Arboretum
entries.pt_excerpt: Arboreto de 623 acres perto de New Ross, dedicado a John F. Kennedy, com mais de 5.000 tipos de árvores e mirante no Slieve Coillte.
entries.en_excerpt: A 623-acre arboretum near New Ross, dedicated to John F. Kennedy, with more than 5,000 varieties of trees and a lookout point on Slieve Coillte.

entries.title: Lough Muckno Leisure Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque lacustre municipal em Castleblayney, com trilhas, parque infantil, pesca e desportos aquáticos, aberto todo o ano.
entries.en_excerpt: A municipal lakeside park in Castleblayney, with walking trails, a playground, fishing and water sports, open all year round.

entries.title: Old Head of Kinsale
entries.pt_excerpt: Ponta rochosa cênica perto de Kinsale, com farol, signal tower e memorial do Lusitania; o percurso exterior e o mirante são de acesso livre.
entries.en_excerpt: A scenic rocky headland near Kinsale, with a lighthouse, signal tower and Lusitania memorial; the outer walk and lookout are freely accessible.

entries.title: Dursey Island
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilha habitada no fim da península de Beara, alcançada pelo único teleférico da Irlanda, com trilhas costeiras e colônias de aves marinhas.
entries.en_excerpt: An inhabited island at the end of the Beara Peninsula, reached by Ireland's only cable car, with coastal trails and seabird colonies.

entries.title: Doagh Famine Village
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu a céu aberto na península de Inishowen que conta a história de uma família de Donegal da Grande Fome até os dias atuais.
entries.en_excerpt: An open-air museum on the Inishowen Peninsula telling the story of a Donegal family from the Great Famine to the present day.

entries.title: The Model
entries.pt_excerpt: Galeria de arte de Sligo e sede da Niland Collection, com importantes obras de Jack B. Yeats e entrada gratuita às galerias.
entries.en_excerpt: Sligo's art gallery and home of the Niland Collection, with important works by Jack B. Yeats and free admission to the galleries.

entries.title: James Joyce Tower Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Torre Martello de 1804 onde começa o Ulysses, hoje museu gratuito com coleção joyceana e vista para a baía de Dublin.
entries.en_excerpt: An 1804 Martello tower where Ulysses opens, today a free museum with a Joycean collection and views over Dublin Bay.

entries.title: Derrigimlagh
entries.pt_excerpt: Turfeira de Connemara com dois marcos do século XX: as ruínas da estação de rádio transatlântica de Marconi e o memorial da travessia de Alcock e Brown.
entries.en_excerpt: A Connemara bogland with two 20th-century landmarks: the ruins of Marconi's transatlantic radio station and the memorial to Alcock and Brown's crossing.

entries.title: The Forty Foot
entries.pt_excerpt: Ponto histórico de banho de mar em Sandycove, no extremo sul da baía de Dublin, com tradição de natação o ano inteiro.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic sea-bathing spot at Sandycove, at the southern tip of Dublin Bay, with a year-round swimming tradition.

entries.title: Chester Beatty
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu de culturas do mundo dentro do Dublin Castle, com entrada gratuita e coleções da Ásia, do Oriente Médio, do Norte da África e da Europa.
entries.en_excerpt: A museum of world cultures inside Dublin Castle, with free entry and collections from Asia, the Middle East, North Africa and Europe.

entries.title: King John’s Castle (Carlingford)
entries.pt_excerpt: Fortaleza normanda do século XII sobre o Carlingford Lough, com salão medieval e vista para as Mourne Mountains.
entries.en_excerpt: A 12th-century Norman fortress above Carlingford Lough, with a medieval hall and views of the Mourne Mountains.

entries.title: Mount Leinster & Nine Stones
entries.pt_excerpt: Ponto mais alto das Blackstairs Mountains (795 m), com mirante dos Nine Stones e vista para quatro condados.
entries.en_excerpt: The highest point of the Blackstairs Mountains (795 m), with the Nine Stones lookout and views over four counties.

entries.title: Oak Park Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Floresta de carvalhos e faías com trilhas, lagos e o Oak Park Lake, perto da cidade de Carlow.
entries.en_excerpt: Woodland of oak and beech with trails, lakes and Oak Park Lake, near the town of Carlow.

entries.title: Borris House
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa ancestral dos MacMurrough Kavanagh, reis de Leinster, com salões Tudor e mercado de artesãos.
entries.en_excerpt: The ancestral home of the MacMurrough Kavanaghs, kings of Leinster, with Tudor halls and a craft market.

entries.title: Huntington Castle & Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo de 1625 da família Durdin-Robertson, com porões medievais, jardins murados e templo druídico.
entries.en_excerpt: A 1625 castle of the Durdin-Robertson family, with medieval cellars, walled gardens and a druidic temple.

entries.title: Duckett’s Grove
entries.pt_excerpt: Ruínas góticas vitorianas da mansão Duckett, com walled gardens restaurados e parque público.
entries.en_excerpt: Victorian Gothic ruins of the Duckett mansion, with restored walled gardens and a public park.

entries.title: Altamont Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins românticos do século XVIII com lago, arboreto e o "corredor de azaleias" — entrada gratuita.
entries.en_excerpt: Romantic 18th-century gardens with a lake, arboretum and the "azalea walk" — free entry.

entries.title: Brownshill Dolmen
entries.pt_excerpt: Dólmen com a maior laje de cobertura da Europa: 100 toneladas de granito sobre pedras de suporte de 5.000 anos.
entries.en_excerpt: A dolmen with the largest capstone in Europe: 100 tonnes of granite resting on 5,000-year-old support stones.

entries.title: Millmount Fort & Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Fortaleza sobre motte normanda com vista de Drogheda, abrigando o museu municipal e a torre Martello.
entries.en_excerpt: A fortress on a Norman motte with views over Drogheda, housing the county museum and the Martello tower.

entries.title: Carlingford Lough Greenway
entries.pt_excerpt: Greenway de 10 km ao longo do lough, entre Carlingford e Newry, com vista para as Mourne Mountains.
entries.en_excerpt: A 10 km greenway along the lough, between Carlingford and Newry, with views of the Mourne Mountains.

entries.title: Mellifont Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Primeira abadia cisterciense da Irlanda (1142), com lavabo octogonal único e ruínas evocativas.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's first Cistercian abbey (1142), with a unique octagonal lavabo and evocative ruins.

entries.title: Monasterboice
entries.pt_excerpt: Sítio monástico com as alta cruzes mais famosas da Irlanda, incluindo a Muiredach's Cross do século X.
entries.en_excerpt: A monastic site with Ireland's most famous high crosses, including the 10th-century Muiredach's Cross.

entries.title: Proleek Dolmen
entries.pt_excerpt: Dólmen megalítico com laje de 40 toneladas, cercado de lendas — quem acertar uma pedra no topo terá sorte.
entries.en_excerpt: A megalithic dolmen with a 40-tonne capstone, wrapped in legend — whoever lands a stone on top will have good luck.

entries.title: Carlingford
entries.pt_excerpt: Vila medieval preservada na costa do Carlingford Lough, com muralhas, castelo e o Carlingford Oyster Festival.
entries.en_excerpt: A preserved medieval village on the shores of Carlingford Lough, with town walls, a castle and the Carlingford Oyster Festival.

entries.title: Mondello Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Único autódromo internacional da Irlanda, com corridas abertas ao público e experiências de pilotagem.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's only international racing circuit, with race meetings open to the public and driving experiences.

entries.title: Lullymore Heritage & Discovery Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque de descoberta numa ilha de calcário na turfeira, com tren, playground, minigolfe e história da turfa.
entries.en_excerpt: A discovery park on a limestone island in the boglands, with a train ride, playground, mini golf and peatland history.

entries.title: Donadea Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Floresta com trilhas, lago, torre do castelo de Aylmer e o 9/11 Memorial Garden.
entries.en_excerpt: A forest park with trails, a lake, the Aylmer castle tower and the 9/11 Memorial Garden.

entries.title: Maynooth Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Fortaleza dos Fitzgerald, os poderosos condes de Kildare, no campus da universidade mais antiga da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A Fitzgerald stronghold of the powerful Earls of Kildare, on the campus of Ireland's oldest university.

entries.title: Pollardstown Fen
entries.pt_excerpt: Maior fen (pântano alcalino) da Irlanda, reserva natural com passarelas e plantas raras de origem glacial.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's largest fen (alkaline marsh), a nature reserve with boardwalks and rare plants of glacial origin.

entries.title: Bog of Allen Nature Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro do Irish Peatland Conservation Council com jardim de sapos, turfeira visitável e exposições sobre pântanos.
entries.en_excerpt: The Irish Peatland Conservation Council's centre, with a frog garden, a walkable bog and exhibitions about peatlands.

entries.title: Castletown House
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão palladiana de 1722, a maior da Irlanda, com salões restaurados e parque aberto ao público.
entries.en_excerpt: A Palladian mansion of 1722, the largest in Ireland, with restored halls and parkland open to the public.

entries.title: Irish National Stud & Japanese Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Haras nacional com garanhões campeões, museu do cavalo e os famosos Jardins Japoneses de 1906.
entries.en_excerpt: The national stud farm with champion stallions, a horse museum and the famous Japanese Gardens of 1906.

entries.title: Curraghchase Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque florestal com ruínas da mansão De Vere, trilhas, lago e colônia de morcegos protegida.
entries.en_excerpt: A forest park with the ruins of the De Vere mansion, trails, a lake and a protected bat colony.

entries.title: Lough Gur
entries.pt_excerpt: Lago em forma de rim cercado por megálitos, círculos de pedra e o Grange Stone Circle, o maior da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A kidney-shaped lake surrounded by megaliths, stone circles and the Grange Stone Circle, the largest in Ireland.

entries.title: Foynes Flying Boat & Maritime Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu na antiga base do Pan Am, com réplica em tamanho real do Boeing 314 e a origem do Irish Coffee.
entries.en_excerpt: A museum on the former Pan Am base, with a full-size replica Boeing 314 and the origins of Irish Coffee.

entries.title: Adare
entries.pt_excerpt: Vila considerada a mais bonita da Irlanda, com cottages de palha, mosteiros e o castelo dos Desmond.
entries.en_excerpt: A village considered Ireland's prettiest, with thatched cottages, monasteries and the Desmond castle.

entries.title: St Mary’s Cathedral
entries.pt_excerpt: Catedral de 1168, o edifício em uso mais antigo de Limerick, com misericórdias medievais raras.
entries.en_excerpt: A cathedral of 1168, Limerick's oldest building still in use, with rare medieval misericords.

entries.title: Hunt Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Coleção de arte e antiguidades dos Hunt, com Picasso, Renoir, Leonardo da Vinci e artefatos célticos.
entries.en_excerpt: The Hunts' collection of art and antiquities, with Picasso, Renoir, Leonardo da Vinci and Celtic artefacts.

entries.title: King John’s Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo normando de 1210 às margens do Shannon, com exposições interativas sobre cercos e história medieval.
entries.en_excerpt: A Norman castle of 1210 on the banks of the Shannon, with interactive exhibitions on sieges and medieval history.

entries.title: Holy Cross Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Abadia cisterciense restaurada do século XII, famosa pela relíquia da Vera Cruz e ainda local de culto.
entries.en_excerpt: A restored 12th-century Cistercian abbey, famous for the relic of the True Cross and still a place of worship.

entries.title: Mitchelstown Cave
entries.pt_excerpt: Uma das maiores cavernas da Europa, com estalactites gigantes, salões enormes e acústica de concertos.
entries.en_excerpt: One of Europe's largest caves, with giant stalactites, vast chambers and concert-hall acoustics.

entries.title: Ormond Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa isabelina única na Irlanda, construída por Tomás Butler, 10º Conde de Ormond, junto a torres medievais.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's only Elizabethan manor house, built by Thomas Butler, 10th Earl of Ormond, alongside medieval towers.

entries.title: The Vee & Bay Lough
entries.pt_excerpt: Passo de montanha em forma de V com mirante sobre o vale do Suir e o lago glaciar Bay Lough.
entries.en_excerpt: A V-shaped mountain pass with a viewpoint over the Suir valley and the glacial lake Bay Lough.

entries.title: Glen of Aherlow
entries.pt_excerpt: Vale cênico entre as Galtee Mountains, com trilhas, mirante do Christ the King e vilas charmosas.
entries.en_excerpt: A scenic valley between the Galtee Mountains, with trails, the Christ the King viewpoint and charming villages.

entries.title: Swiss Cottage
entries.pt_excerpt: Chalé ornamental de 1810, exemplo perfeito do estilo "picturesque", com interior restaurado e floresta.
entries.en_excerpt: An ornamental cottage of 1810, a perfect example of the "picturesque" style, with a restored interior and woodland.

entries.title: Cahir Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Um dos castelos mais bem preservados da Irlanda, do século XIII, numa ilha do rio Suir.
entries.en_excerpt: One of Ireland's best-preserved castles, from the 13th century, on an island in the River Suir.

entries.title: Rock of Cashel
entries.pt_excerpt: Conjunto medieval espetacular sobre afloramento de calcário: catedral gótica, capela românica e torre redonda.
entries.en_excerpt: A spectacular medieval complex on a limestone outcrop: Gothic cathedral, Romanesque chapel and round tower.

entries.title: Tintern Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Abadia cisterciense fundada em 1200 por William Marshal, com colunata vitoriana e vale arborizado.
entries.en_excerpt: A Cistercian abbey founded in 1200 by William Marshal, with a Victorian colonnade and a wooded valley.

entries.title: Ferns Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo normando do século XIII com capela em cruz e vitrais modernos, na antiga capital dos reis de Leinster.
entries.en_excerpt: A 13th-century Norman castle with a cruciform chapel and modern stained glass, in the former capital of the kings of Leinster.

entries.title: Wexford Wildfowl Reserve
entries.pt_excerpt: Reserva natural no North Slob, refúgio de inverno de um terço da população mundial de gansos-de-frente-branca da Groenlândia.
entries.en_excerpt: A nature reserve on the North Slob, winter home to one third of the world's Greenland white-fronted geese.

entries.title: Curracloe Beach
entries.pt_excerpt: Praia de 11 km de areia fina, cenário da abertura de "O Resgate do Soldado Ryan", com dunas e trilhas.
entries.en_excerpt: An 11 km stretch of fine sandy beach, location of the opening of "Saving Private Ryan", with dunes and trails.

entries.title: Saltee Islands
entries.pt_excerpt: Santuário de aves marinhas com uma das maiores colônias de gansos-patola da Irlanda, acessível por barco de Kilmore Quay.
entries.en_excerpt: A seabird sanctuary with one of Ireland's largest gannet colonies, reachable by boat from Kilmore Quay.

entries.title: Dunbrody Famine Ship
entries.pt_excerpt: Réplica fiel de um navio de emigrantes da Grande Fome, com tour imersivo sobre a travessia do Atlântico.
entries.en_excerpt: A faithful replica of a Great Famine emigrant ship, with an immersive tour of the Atlantic crossing.

entries.title: Hook Lighthouse
entries.pt_excerpt: Farol medieval em operação desde o século XIII — um dos mais antigos do mundo — com tours e café.
entries.en_excerpt: A medieval lighthouse in operation since the 13th century — one of the oldest in the world — with tours and a café.

entries.title: Johnstown Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo neogótico do século XIX com lagos, jardins e o Museu da Agricultura Irlandesa.
entries.en_excerpt: A 19th-century neo-Gothic castle with lakes, gardens and the Irish Agricultural Museum.

entries.title: Irish National Heritage Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque de 35 acres que recria 9.000 anos de história irlandesa: cabanas do mesolítico, crannóg, mosteiro e anel normando.
entries.en_excerpt: A 35-acre park recreating 9,000 years of Irish history: Mesolithic huts, a crannóg, a monastery and a Norman ringwork.

entries.title: Coumshingaun Loop (Comeragh Mountains)
entries.pt_excerpt: Trilha circular em torno de um lago glaciar num circo de falésias — uma das caminhadas mais espetaculares do sul.
entries.en_excerpt: A circular trail around a glacial lake in an amphitheatre of cliffs — one of the most spectacular walks in the south.

entries.title: Ardmore Round Tower & Cathedral
entries.pt_excerpt: Sítio monástico de São Declan com torre redonda de 30 m, catedral com esculturas e oratório primitivo.
entries.en_excerpt: St Declan's monastic site with a 30 m round tower, a carved cathedral and an early oratory.

entries.title: Lismore Castle Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins históricos do castelo dos duques de Devonshire, com upper e lower gardens sobre o rio Blackwater.
entries.en_excerpt: Historic gardens of the castle of the Dukes of Devonshire, with upper and lower gardens above the River Blackwater.

entries.title: Mount Congreve Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Um dos maiores jardins privados da Europa, com 70 acres de azaleias, rododendros e bosques plantados por Ambrose Congreve.
entries.en_excerpt: One of Europe's largest private gardens, with 70 acres of azaleas, rhododendrons and woodlands planted by Ambrose Congreve.

entries.title: Copper Coast Geopark
entries.pt_excerpt: Litoral de 25 km com falésias, praias e geologia vulcânica de 460 milhões de anos, patrimônio UNESCO.
entries.en_excerpt: A 25 km coastline of cliffs, beaches and 460-million-year-old volcanic geology, a UNESCO heritage site.

entries.title: Waterford Greenway
entries.pt_excerpt: Greenway de 46 km sobre antiga ferrovia, com viadutos, túnel e travessia do rio Suir — a mais popular da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A 46 km greenway along a former railway, with viaducts, a tunnel and a crossing of the River Suir — the most popular in Ireland.

entries.title: Reginald’s Tower
entries.pt_excerpt: Torre viking do século XIII, o edifício civil mais antigo da Irlanda em uso contínuo.
entries.en_excerpt: A 13th-century Viking tower, Ireland's oldest civic building in continuous use.

entries.title: Waterford Treasures Museums
entries.pt_excerpt: Conjunto de museus sobre a Irlanda viking e medieval, no coração do Viking Triangle.
entries.en_excerpt: A group of museums about Viking and medieval Ireland, in the heart of the Viking Triangle.

entries.title: House of Waterford Crystal
entries.pt_excerpt: Fábrica e centro de visitantes do cristal Waterford, com tour pela produção e galeria de peças únicas.
entries.en_excerpt: The Waterford Crystal factory and visitor centre, with a tour of the production floor and a gallery of one-of-a-kind pieces.

entries.title: Woodstock Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins vitorianos restaurados da mansão Tighe, com arboreto, avenue de teixos e vista do vale do Nore.
entries.en_excerpt: Restored Victorian gardens of the Tighe mansion, with an arboretum, an avenue of yews and views over the Nore valley.

entries.title: Jerpoint Park (Newtown Jerpoint)
entries.pt_excerpt: Cidade medieval perdida de Newtown Jerpoint, com igreja de São Nicolau e lendas sobre o santo.
entries.en_excerpt: The lost medieval town of Newtown Jerpoint, with the church of St Nicholas and legends about the saint.

entries.title: Castlecomer Discovery Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque de aventura em 80 acres de floresta, com arborismo, zip lines, canoagem e trilhas.
entries.en_excerpt: An adventure park in 80 acres of woodland, with treetop walks, zip lines, canoeing and trails.

entries.title: Dunmore Cave
entries.pt_excerpt: Caverna de calcário com formações dramáticas e história ligada a um ataque viking do século X.
entries.en_excerpt: A limestone cave with dramatic formations and a history linked to a 10th-century Viking attack.

entries.title: Smithwick’s Experience
entries.pt_excerpt: Tour pela antiga cervejaria de Kilkenny, onde o ale Smithwick's é produzido desde 1710.
entries.en_excerpt: A tour of Kilkenny's former brewery, where Smithwick's ale has been brewed since 1710.

entries.title: Rothe House & Garden
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa mercantil tudor do século XVII, única do tipo aberta ao público na Irlanda, com jardim de recriação histórica.
entries.en_excerpt: A 17th-century Tudor merchant's house, the only one of its kind open to the public in Ireland, with a historically recreated garden.

entries.title: Jerpoint Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Abadia cisterciense do século XII com esculturas góticas excepcionais e figuras esculpidas nos túmulos.
entries.en_excerpt: A 12th-century Cistercian abbey with exceptional Gothic carvings and sculpted figures on its tombs.

entries.title: Medieval Mile Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu na igreja de St Mary sobre a Kilkenny medieval, com cripta e lápidas dos mercadores.
entries.en_excerpt: A museum in St Mary's Church about medieval Kilkenny, with a crypt and merchants' tombstones.

entries.title: Kilkenny Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo normando de 1195, sede dos duques de Ormonde por seis séculos, com jardins vitorianos.
entries.en_excerpt: A Norman castle of 1195, seat of the Dukes of Ormonde for six centuries, with Victorian gardens.

entries.title: Clare Island
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilha da pirata Grace O'Malley na entrada de Clew Bay, com abadia muralhada, farol e trilhas costeiras.
entries.en_excerpt: Grace O'Malley's pirate island at the mouth of Clew Bay, with a walled abbey, a lighthouse and coastal trails.

entries.title: Wild Nephin Ballycroy National Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque nacional de turfeiras selvagens e montanhas Nephin, com centro de visitantes e céus escuros.
entries.en_excerpt: A national park of wild blanket bogs and the Nephin mountains, with a visitor centre and dark skies.

entries.title: Great Western Greenway
entries.pt_excerpt: Greenway de 42 km sobre antiga ferrovia, de Westport a Achill, um dos passeios de bicicleta mais bonitos da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A 42 km greenway along a former railway, from Westport to Achill — one of Ireland's most beautiful cycle rides.

entries.title: Céide Fields
entries.pt_excerpt: Sistema agrícola neolítico de 5.500 anos, o mais extenso do mundo, sob a turfeira do norte de Mayo.
entries.en_excerpt: A 5,500-year-old Neolithic field system, the most extensive in the world, beneath the blanket bog of north Mayo.

entries.title: Downpatrick Head
entries.pt_excerpt: Cabeço com o sea stack Dún Briste ("rota quebrada"), igreja antiga e poço de São Patrício sobre o Atlântico.
entries.en_excerpt: A headland with the Dún Briste sea stack ("broken track"), an old church and St Patrick's well above the Atlantic.

entries.title: National Museum of Ireland – Country Life
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu nacional da vida rural irlandesa, num parque com jardins e moinho, entrada gratuita.
entries.en_excerpt: The national museum of Irish rural life, in grounds with gardens and a mill — free entry.

entries.title: Westport House & Adventure Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão georgiana da família Browne com parque de aventura, zoológico pequeno e terrenos históricos.
entries.en_excerpt: A Georgian mansion of the Browne family with an adventure park, a small zoo and historic grounds.

entries.title: Keem Bay
entries.pt_excerpt: Baía em forma de ferradura com areia branca, eleita repetidamente entre as praias mais bonitas da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A horseshoe-shaped bay of white sand, repeatedly voted among Ireland's most beautiful beaches.

entries.title: Achill Island
entries.pt_excerpt: Maior ilha da Irlanda, ligada por ponte, com falésias de Croaghaun, praias selvagens e vila de Keel.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's largest island, linked by a bridge, with the Croaghaun cliffs, wild beaches and the village of Keel.

entries.title: Croagh Patrick
entries.pt_excerpt: Montanha sagrada de São Patrício (764 m), com peregrinação anual e vista sobre Clew Bay e suas 365 ilhotas.
entries.en_excerpt: St Patrick's holy mountain (764 m), with an annual pilgrimage and views over Clew Bay and its 365 islands.

entries.title: Eagles Flying
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro irlandês de aves de rapina com demonstrações de voo de águias, falcões e corujas.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's birds-of-prey centre with flying displays of eagles, falcons and owls.

entries.title: Drumcliffe
entries.pt_excerpt: Sítio monástico do século VI com alta cruz e torre redonda, onde está o túmulo de W.B. Yeats.
entries.en_excerpt: A 6th-century monastic site with a high cross and round tower, where W.B. Yeats is buried.

entries.title: Lissadell House
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão dos Gore-Booth, ligada a Constance Markievicz e a Yeats, com jardins e galeria de exposições.
entries.en_excerpt: The Gore-Booth family mansion, linked to Constance Markievicz and Yeats, with gardens and an exhibition gallery.

entries.title: Sligo Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Abadia dominicana do século XIII, única com altar-mor medieval original preservado na Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A 13th-century Dominican abbey, the only one in Ireland with its original medieval high altar preserved.

entries.title: Queen Maeve’s Trail (Knocknarea)
entries.pt_excerpt: Trilha até o cairn de pedra da rainha Medb no topo do Knocknarea, com vista de Sligo e do Atlântico.
entries.en_excerpt: A trail up to Queen Medb's cairn of stones on the summit of Knocknarea, with views of Sligo and the Atlantic.

entries.title: Carrowmore Megalithic Cemetery
entries.pt_excerpt: Maior conjunto de túmulos megalíticos da Irlanda, com mais de 5.500 anos, sob o olhar do Knocknarea.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's largest concentration of megalithic tombs, over 5,500 years old, beneath the gaze of Knocknarea.

entries.title: Strandhill Beach
entries.pt_excerpt: Praia de surf aos pés do Knocknarea, com escolas de surf, banhos de sargaço e pôr do sol famoso.
entries.en_excerpt: A surfing beach at the foot of Knocknarea, with surf schools, seaweed baths and a famous sunset.

entries.title: Benbulben
entries.pt_excerpt: Mesa de calcário símbolo de Sligo, imortalizada por Yeats, com trilha na crista e caminhada fácil na base.
entries.en_excerpt: A limestone table mountain and symbol of Sligo, immortalised by Yeats, with a ridge trail and an easy walk at its base.

entries.title: Ards Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Península florestal com praias, ruínas franciscanas e trilhas costeiras de frente para Sheephaven Bay.
entries.en_excerpt: A forested peninsula with beaches, Franciscan ruins and coastal trails facing Sheephaven Bay.

entries.title: Errigal
entries.pt_excerpt: Montanha mais alta de Donegal (751 m), com subida íngreme e panorama sobre o Poisoned Glen.
entries.en_excerpt: Donegal's highest mountain (751 m), with a steep climb and a panorama over the Poisoned Glen.

entries.title: Grianán of Aileach
entries.pt_excerpt: Fortaleza de pedra do século VI/VII no topo do Greenan Mountain, antiga sede dos reis de Tyrconnell.
entries.en_excerpt: A 6th/7th-century stone fort on top of Greenan Mountain, former seat of the kings of Tyrconnell.

entries.title: Fanad Head Lighthouse
entries.pt_excerpt: Farol icônico de 1817 entre as praias de Fanad, com tours internos e hospedagem no farol.
entries.en_excerpt: An iconic 1817 lighthouse among the Fanad beaches, with interior tours and lighthouse accommodation.

entries.title: Malin Head
entries.pt_excerpt: Ponto mais ao norte da Irlanda, com torre de sinais napoleônica, locações de Star Wars e vistas do Atlântico.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's northernmost point, with a Napoleonic signal tower, Star Wars filming locations and Atlantic views.

entries.title: Donegal Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Fortaleza dos O'Donnell restaurada com mansão jacobina anexa, no centro de Donegal Town.
entries.en_excerpt: A restored O'Donnell fortress with an adjoining Jacobean mansion, in the centre of Donegal Town.

entries.title: Sliabh Liag (Slieve League)
entries.pt_excerpt: Falésias marinhas de quase 600 metros — entre as mais altas da Europa — com a trilha One Man’s Pass.
entries.en_excerpt: Sea cliffs of almost 600 metres — among the highest in Europe — with the One Man's Pass trail.

entries.title: Glenveagh National Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Segundo maior parque nacional da Irlanda, com castelo, jardins, vales glaciais e águias-reais reintroduzidas.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's second-largest national park, with a castle, gardens, glacial valleys and reintroduced golden eagles.

entries.title: Sliabh Beagh
entries.pt_excerpt: Planalto de turfeira na fronteira com a Irlanda do Norte, com trilhas, mirante e centro de visitantes.
entries.en_excerpt: A bogland plateau on the border with Northern Ireland, with trails, a viewpoint and a visitor centre.

entries.title: Patrick Kavanagh Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro dedicado ao poeta Patrick Kavanagh na igreja antiga de Inniskeen, sua terra natal.
entries.en_excerpt: A centre dedicated to the poet Patrick Kavanagh in the old church of Inniskeen, his birthplace.

entries.title: Carrickmacross Lace Gallery
entries.pt_excerpt: Ateliê e galeria da famosa renda de Carrickmacross, técnica usada no vestido de noiva de Diana, princesa de Gales.
entries.en_excerpt: A studio and gallery of the famous Carrickmacross lace, the technique used in the wedding dress of Diana, Princess of Wales.

entries.title: Monaghan County Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Primeiro museu de condado da Irlanda, premiado, com coleções sobre artesanato, conflitos e vida rural.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's first county museum, award-winning, with collections on crafts, conflict and rural life.

entries.title: Rossmore Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Antiga propriedade dos Rossmore com trilhas, esculturas de madeira, lagos e ruínas de portais.
entries.en_excerpt: A former Rossmore estate with trails, wooden sculptures, lakes and the ruins of old gateways.

entries.title: Castle Leslie Estate
entries.pt_excerpt: Propriedade da família Leslie desde 1660, com castelo vitoriano, centro equestre, lago e trilhas.
entries.en_excerpt: A Leslie family estate since 1660, with a Victorian castle, an equestrian centre, a lake and trails.

entries.title: Belturbet Railway Station
entries.pt_excerpt: Estação ferroviária de bitola estreita restaurada, com museu ferroviário e vagões de época.
entries.en_excerpt: A restored narrow-gauge railway station, with a railway museum and period carriages.

entries.title: Cavan County Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu premiado com a maior réplica de trincheira da Primeira Guerra Mundial ao ar livre na Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: An award-winning museum with Ireland's largest outdoor First World War trench replica.

entries.title: Shannon Pot
entries.pt_excerpt: Nascente do rio Shannon, o mais longo da Irlanda, num poço cárstico nas encostas do Cuilcagh.
entries.en_excerpt: The source of the River Shannon, Ireland's longest river, in a karst pool on the slopes of Cuilcagh.

entries.title: Dún a Rí Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque florestal com cabanas de gelo, ponte romana e lendas locais, nas margens do rio Cabra.
entries.en_excerpt: A forest park with ice houses, a Roman bridge and local legends, on the banks of the River Cabra.

entries.title: Killykeen Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Penínsulas florestais entre as ilhotas do Lough Oughter, com trilhas, caiaque e pesca.
entries.en_excerpt: Wooded peninsulas among the islands of Lough Oughter, with trails, kayaking and fishing.

entries.title: Cavan Burren Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Paisagem cárstica com megálitos, dolmens e trilhas interpretativas no Geoparque Global Marble Arch Caves.
entries.en_excerpt: A karst landscape with megaliths, dolmens and interpretive trails in the Marble Arch Caves Global Geopark.

entries.title: Seán Mac Diarmada Cottage
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa natal de um dos signatários da Proclamação de 1916, preservada como museu no norte de Leitrim.
entries.en_excerpt: The birthplace of one of the signatories of the 1916 Proclamation, preserved as a museum in north Leitrim.

entries.title: Lough Rynn Castle Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins históricos da propriedade dos Clements, com labirinto, walled garden e vista para o lago.
entries.en_excerpt: Historic gardens of the Clements estate, with a maze, a walled garden and views over the lake.

entries.title: Lough Allen
entries.pt_excerpt: Lago serrilhado no alto do Shannon, cercado pelas montanhas de Arigna e Sliabh an Iarainn.
entries.en_excerpt: A jagged lake on the upper Shannon, ringed by the Arigna and Sliabh an Iarainn mountains.

entries.title: Acres Lake Floating Boardwalk
entries.pt_excerpt: Passarela flutuante de 600 m sobre o Lough Allen, parte do Shannon Blueway, com trilhas e caiaque.
entries.en_excerpt: A 600 m floating boardwalk over Lough Allen, part of the Shannon Blueway, with trails and kayaking.

entries.title: Parke’s Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo-forte do século XVII restaurado às margens do Lough Gill, com exposição sobre o plantation.
entries.en_excerpt: A restored 17th-century fortified castle on the shores of Lough Gill, with an exhibition about the plantation.

entries.title: Glencar Waterfall
entries.pt_excerpt: Cascata de 15 metros imortalizada por W.B. Yeats, perto de Sligo, com trilha curta e área de piquenique.
entries.en_excerpt: A 15-metre waterfall immortalised by W.B. Yeats, near Sligo, with a short trail and a picnic area.

entries.title: Roscommon Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo normando do século XIII em ruínas evocativas, com parque público e lago ao redor.
entries.en_excerpt: A 13th-century Norman castle in evocative ruins, surrounded by a public park and lake.

entries.title: Lough Key Forest & Activity Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque florestal com ilhas, torre de observação, zip line, bungalows e trilhas para todas as idades.
entries.en_excerpt: A forest park with islands, an observation tower, a zip line, bungalows and trails for all ages.

entries.title: Arigna Mining Experience
entries.pt_excerpt: Tour guiado por mina de carvão real conduzido por ex-mineradores, nas colinas de Arigna.
entries.en_excerpt: A guided tour of a real coal mine led by former miners, in the Arigna hills.

entries.title: Strokestown Park & National Famine Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão georgiana com o Museu Nacional da Grande Fome e jardins murados restaurados.
entries.en_excerpt: A Georgian mansion with the National Famine Museum and restored walled gardens.

entries.title: Boyle Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Abadia cisterciense do século XII com claustro impressionante, no coração de Boyle.
entries.en_excerpt: A 12th-century Cistercian abbey with an impressive cloister, in the heart of Boyle.

entries.title: Rathcroghan
entries.pt_excerpt: Capital real antiga de Connacht e porta de entrada para o outro mundo na mitologia irlandesa.
entries.en_excerpt: The ancient royal capital of Connacht and gateway to the Otherworld in Irish mythology.

entries.title: Lough Ree
entries.pt_excerpt: Grande lago do rio Shannon com ilhas, pesca, passeios de barco e praias fluviais.
entries.en_excerpt: A great lake on the River Shannon with islands, fishing, boat trips and riverside beaches.

entries.title: Newcastle Wood
entries.pt_excerpt: Floresta de coníferas e folhosas com trilhas tranquilas perto de Ballymahon.
entries.en_excerpt: A forest of conifers and broadleaves with peaceful trails near Ballymahon.

entries.title: Royal Canal Greenway
entries.pt_excerpt: Greenway de 130 km ao longo do Royal Canal, de Dublin a Cloondara — o trecho final fica em Longford.
entries.en_excerpt: A 130 km greenway along the Royal Canal, from Dublin to Cloondara — the final stretch is in Longford.

entries.title: Granard Motte & Bailey
entries.pt_excerpt: Motte normanda do século XII sobre morro antigo, com estátua de Santa Kitirine e vistas amplas.
entries.en_excerpt: A 12th-century Norman motte on an ancient hill, with a St Kitirine statue and wide views.

entries.title: Ardagh Heritage Village
entries.pt_excerpt: Vila vencedora de prêmios de conservação, com verde central pitoresco e centro de interpretação.
entries.en_excerpt: An award-winning heritage village, with a picturesque village green and an interpretive centre.

entries.title: Corlea Trackway Visitor Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro que protege uma estrada de carvalho de 2.000 anos construída sobre a turfeira, única na Europa.
entries.en_excerpt: A centre protecting a 2,000-year-old oak road built across the bog, the only one of its kind in Europe.

entries.title: Glendeer Pet Farm
entries.pt_excerpt: Fazenda de animais aberta ao público com cabras, cordeiros, aves e playground coberto.
entries.en_excerpt: An animal farm open to visitors, with goats, lambs, birds and an indoor playground.

entries.title: Mullaghmeen Forest
entries.pt_excerpt: Grande floresta de folhosas plantadas, com trilhas e vista para o Lough Derravaragh.
entries.en_excerpt: A large planted broadleaf forest, with trails and views over Lough Derravaragh.

entries.title: Kilbeggan Distillery Experience
entries.pt_excerpt: Destilaria licenciada mais antiga do mundo (1757), com moinho a vapor funcionando e degustações.
entries.en_excerpt: The world's oldest licensed distillery (1757), with a working steam mill and tastings.

entries.title: Athlone Castle Visitor Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo normando do século XII no rio Shannon, com museu interativo sobre o cerco de Athlone.
entries.en_excerpt: A 12th-century Norman castle on the River Shannon, with an interactive museum about the Siege of Athlone.

entries.title: Belvedere House Gardens & Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa de campo do século XVIII com jardins, folly "Jealous Wall" e eventos familiares o ano inteiro.
entries.en_excerpt: An 18th-century country house with gardens, the "Jealous Wall" folly and family events all year round.

entries.title: Tullamore D.E.W. Experience
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro de visitantes do whisky Tullamore D.E.W. num armazém do século XIX, com degustações guiadas.
entries.en_excerpt: The Tullamore D.E.W. whiskey visitor centre in a 19th-century warehouse, with guided tastings.

entries.title: Charleville Forest Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo neogótico do século XIX cercado por floresta antiga de carvalhos, com tours e eventos.
entries.en_excerpt: A 19th-century neo-Gothic castle surrounded by ancient oak woodland, with tours and events.

entries.title: Lough Boora Discovery Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque de turfeiras regeneradas com esculturas ao ar livre, trilhas de caminhada e ciclismo e aves raras.
entries.en_excerpt: A park of regenerated boglands with outdoor sculptures, walking and cycling trails and rare birds.

entries.title: Birr Castle Demesne
entries.pt_excerpt: Propriedade científica dos Parsons com jardins premiados, o telescópio gigante do século XIX e centro de ciência.
entries.en_excerpt: The Parsons' scientific estate with award-winning gardens, the giant 19th-century telescope and a science centre.

entries.title: Clonmacnoise
entries.pt_excerpt: Um dos mosteiros mais importantes da Europa medieval, às margens do rio Shannon, com torres redondas e alta cruzes.
entries.en_excerpt: One of medieval Europe's most important monasteries, on the banks of the River Shannon, with round towers and high crosses.

entries.title: Slieve Bloom Mountains
entries.pt_excerpt: Montanhas de turfeira e floresta entre Laois e Offaly, com trilhas, cachoeiras e mirantes panorâmicos.
entries.en_excerpt: Mountains of bogland and forest between Laois and Offaly, with trails, waterfalls and panoramic viewpoints.

entries.title: Abbeyleix Heritage House
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro de patrimônio que conta a história planejada da vila georgiana de Abbeyleix e do tapete local.
entries.en_excerpt: A heritage centre telling the story of planned Georgian Abbeyleix and of the local carpet industry.

entries.title: Timahoe Round Tower
entries.pt_excerpt: Torre redonda do século XII considerada uma das mais belas da Irlanda, com portal ricamente decorado.
entries.en_excerpt: A 12th-century round tower considered one of Ireland's most beautiful, with a richly decorated doorway.

entries.title: Heywood Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins formais dos séculos XVIII/XIX com terraços, lago e o famoso "jardim secreto" circular.
entries.en_excerpt: Formal 18th/19th-century gardens with terraces, a lake and the famous circular "secret garden".

entries.title: Emo Court
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão neoclássica do século XVIII com jardins e lago desenhados por Capability Brown; entrada gratuita.
entries.en_excerpt: An 18th-century neoclassical mansion with gardens and a lake designed by Capability Brown; free entry.

entries.title: Rock of Dunamase
entries.pt_excerpt: Fortaleza normanda em ruínas sobre afloramento rochoso, com vistas de 360° pelo interior de Laois.
entries.en_excerpt: A ruined Norman fortress on a rocky outcrop, with 360° views across the Laois countryside.

entries.title: Banna Strand
entries.pt_excerpt: Praia extensa de areia dourada ao norte de Tralee, com dunas e águas ideais para surf e banho.
entries.en_excerpt: A long beach of golden sand north of Tralee, with dunes and waters ideal for surfing and swimming.

entries.title: Muckross Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Abadia franciscana do século XV com claustro e um enorme teixo central, no coração do parque nacional.
entries.en_excerpt: A 15th-century Franciscan abbey with a cloister and a huge central yew tree, in the heart of the national park.

entries.title: Gallarus Oratory
entries.pt_excerpt: Oratório cristão primitivo em pedra seca, com mais de 1.200 anos, em forma de casco de barco invertido.
entries.en_excerpt: An early Christian dry-stone oratory, over 1,200 years old, shaped like an upturned boat.

entries.title: Derrynane House & National Historic Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Casa de Daniel O'Connell, o Libertador, dentro de um parque costeiro com praia e jardins subtropicais.
entries.en_excerpt: The house of Daniel O'Connell, the Liberator, within a coastal park with a beach and subtropical gardens.

entries.title: Kerry Cliffs
entries.pt_excerpt: Falésias de mais de 300 metros com vista para Skellig Michael, no Anel de Skellig.
entries.en_excerpt: Cliffs over 300 metres high with views of Skellig Michael, on the Skellig Ring.

entries.title: Valentia Island
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilha conectada por ponte e ferry, com pegadas de dinossauro, jardins subtropicais e o farol de Cromwell Point.
entries.en_excerpt: An island linked by bridge and ferry, with dinosaur footprints, subtropical gardens and the Cromwell Point lighthouse.

entries.title: Skellig Michael
entries.pt_excerpt: Patrimônio Mundial da UNESCO: mosteiro do século VI no topo de ilha rochosa no Atlântico, cenário de Star Wars.
entries.en_excerpt: A UNESCO World Heritage Site: a 6th-century monastery atop a rocky island in the Atlantic, a Star Wars filming location.

entries.title: Doneraile Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque paisagístico do século XVIII com cervos, trilhas e playground, entrada gratuita.
entries.en_excerpt: An 18th-century landscaped park with deer, trails and a playground — free entry.

entries.title: Spike Island
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilha-fortaleza no porto de Cork, já a maior prisão do mundo, hoje museu premiado acessível por ferry.
entries.en_excerpt: A fortress island in Cork harbour, once the world's largest prison, today an award-winning museum reached by ferry.

entries.title: Garnish Island
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilha-jardim na baía de Glengarriff, famosa pelos jardins italianos, torre martelo e focas no trajeto de barco.
entries.en_excerpt: A garden island in Glengarriff harbour, famous for its Italian gardens, Martello tower and the seals seen on the boat trip.

entries.title: Blackrock Castle Observatory
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo do século XVI transformado em observatório de ciências astronômicas às margens do rio Lee.
entries.en_excerpt: A 16th-century castle turned astronomical science observatory on the banks of the River Lee.

entries.title: Cork City Gaol
entries.pt_excerpt: Antiga prisão vitoriana com figuras de cera e audioguia sobre dois séculos de vida carcerária.
entries.en_excerpt: A former Victorian prison with wax figures and an audio guide covering two centuries of prison life.

entries.title: English Market
entries.pt_excerpt: Mercado coberto histórico do século XVIII, templo da gastronomia de Cork com bancas de peixe, queijos e quitandas.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic 18th-century covered market, a temple of Cork gastronomy with stalls of fish, cheeses and baked goods.

entries.title: Vandeleur Walled Garden
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardim murado do século XIX restaurado, com estufa vitoriana e café, no oeste de Clare.
entries.en_excerpt: A restored 19th-century walled garden, with a Victorian glasshouse and a café, in west Clare.

entries.title: Craggaunowen
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque de história viva que recria a Irlanda pré-histórica e medieval, com crannóg e casa fortificada.
entries.en_excerpt: A living-history park recreating prehistoric and medieval Ireland, with a crannóg and a fortified house.

entries.title: Spanish Point Beach
entries.pt_excerpt: Baía de areia com águas calmas e história ligada à Armada Espanhola, popular para famílias e surf.
entries.en_excerpt: A sandy bay with calm waters and history linked to the Spanish Armada, popular with families and surfers.

entries.title: Holy Island (Inis Cealtra)
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilha sagrada no Lough Derg com mosteiro do século VII, células de pedra e cruzes antigas.
entries.en_excerpt: A holy island on Lough Derg with a 7th-century monastery, stone cells and ancient crosses.

entries.title: Scattery Island
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilha monástica no estuário do Shannon, com torre redonda, ruínas de igrejas e colônia de focas.
entries.en_excerpt: A monastic island in the Shannon estuary, with a round tower, church ruins and a seal colony.

entries.title: Ennis Friary
entries.pt_excerpt: Convento franciscano do século XIII com esculturas medievais notáveis, no centro de Ennis.
entries.en_excerpt: A 13th-century Franciscan friary with notable medieval carvings, in the centre of Ennis.

entries.title: Thoor Ballylee
entries.pt_excerpt: Torre normanda do século XIV onde viveu o poeta W.B. Yeats, chamada por ele de "o lugar mais bonito do mundo".
entries.en_excerpt: A 14th-century Norman tower where the poet W.B. Yeats lived, called by him "the most beautiful place on earth".

entries.title: Portumna Castle & Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão fortificada do século XVII às margens do Lough Derg, com jardins restaurados e parque florestal.
entries.en_excerpt: A 17th-century fortified mansion on the shores of Lough Derg, with restored gardens and a forest park.

entries.title: Coole Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Reserva natural e antiga propriedade de Lady Gregory, coração do Renascimento Literário irlandês.
entries.en_excerpt: A nature reserve and former Lady Gregory estate, heart of the Irish Literary Revival.

entries.title: Brigit’s Garden
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins inspirados nas festas celtas, com jardim solar, floresta antiga e playground natural.
entries.en_excerpt: Gardens inspired by the Celtic festivals, with a sun garden, ancient woodland and a natural playground.

entries.title: Galway City Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu moderno sobre a história de Galway, do período medieval à cultura das Ilhas Aran.
entries.en_excerpt: A modern museum on the history of Galway, from the medieval period to the culture of the Aran Islands.

entries.title: Spanish Arch & Long Walk
entries.pt_excerpt: Arco do século XVI à beira do rio Corrib e as coloridas casas do Long Walk, cartão-postal de Galway.
entries.en_excerpt: A 16th-century arch on the River Corrib and the colourful houses of the Long Walk, a Galway postcard view.

entries.title: Dowth Passage Tomb
entries.pt_excerpt: Terceiro grande túmulo de passagem do Brú na Bóinne, com 5.000 anos, aberto a visitas guiadas.
entries.en_excerpt: The third great passage tomb of Brú na Bóinne, 5,000 years old, open to guided visits.

entries.title: Sonairte Ecology Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro de ecologia e horta orgânica numa fazenda histórica perto do mar, com trilhas e loja vegetariana.
entries.en_excerpt: An ecology centre and organic garden on a historic farm near the sea, with trails and a vegetarian café.

entries.title: Kells Historic Town
entries.pt_excerpt: Vila monástica histórica, antiga casa do Livro de Kells, com alta cruzes e torre redonda.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic monastic town, former home of the Book of Kells, with high crosses and a round tower.

entries.title: Bective Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Ruínas de abadia cisterciense do século XII às margens do rio Boyne, cenário do filme Braveheart.
entries.en_excerpt: Ruins of a 12th-century Cistercian abbey on the banks of the River Boyne, a filming location for Braveheart.

entries.title: Emerald Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque temático e zoológico (antigo Tayto Park) com montanhas-russas, zoo e atrações para toda a família.
entries.en_excerpt: A theme park and zoo (formerly Tayto Park) with roller coasters, a zoo and attractions for the whole family.

entries.title: The Wicklow Way
entries.pt_excerpt: A trilha de longa distância mais antiga da Irlanda: 131 km pelas montanhas de Wicklow, de Dublin a Clonegal.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's oldest long-distance trail: 131 km through the Wicklow Mountains, from Dublin to Clonegal.

entries.title: Mount Usher Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins românticos às margens do rio Vartry, com plantas de todo o mundo e estilo de jardim selvagem.
entries.en_excerpt: Romantic gardens on the banks of the River Vartry, with plants from all over the world and a wild-garden style.

entries.title: Killruddery House & Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão do século XVII ainda habitada, com jardins formais, orangerie e mercado de produtores aos sábados.
entries.en_excerpt: A 17th-century mansion still lived in, with formal gardens, an orangery and a farmers' market on Saturdays.

entries.title: Brittas Bay Beach
entries.pt_excerpt: Uma das melhores praias da costa leste, com 4 km de areia dourada e dunas protegidas.
entries.en_excerpt: One of the east coast's finest beaches, with 4 km of golden sand and protected dunes.

entries.title: Wicklow’s Historic Gaol
entries.pt_excerpt: Prisão histórica do século XVIII transformada em museu interativo sobre dois séculos de história sombria.
entries.en_excerpt: An 18th-century prison turned interactive museum on two centuries of dark history.

entries.title: Russborough House
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão palladiana do século XVIII com interior ornamentado, labirinto e vista para as montanhas de Wicklow.
entries.en_excerpt: An 18th-century Palladian mansion with an ornate interior, a maze and views of the Wicklow Mountains.

entries.title: Portmarnock Beach (Velvet Strand)
entries.pt_excerpt: Longa praia de areia ao norte de Dublin, popular para caminhadas, banhos e esportes aquáticos.
entries.en_excerpt: A long sandy beach north of Dublin, popular for walks, swimming and water sports.

entries.title: Dún Laoghaire East Pier
entries.pt_excerpt: Calçadão marítimo de 1,3 km com vistas da baía de Dublin, ideal para caminhadas à beira-mar.
entries.en_excerpt: A 1.3 km seafront promenade with views of Dublin Bay, ideal for a walk by the sea.

entries.title: Glasnevin Cemetery Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Cemitério histórico onde repousam os grandes nomes da independência irlandesa, com museu e visitas guiadas.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic cemetery where the great names of Irish independence rest, with a museum and guided tours.

entries.title: National Botanic Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Jardins botânicos nacionais com estufas vitorianas, mais de 15 mil espécies de plantas e entrada gratuita.
entries.en_excerpt: The national botanic gardens with Victorian glasshouses, more than 15,000 plant species and free entry.

entries.title: EPIC The Irish Emigration Museum
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu interativo premiado que conta a história dos 10 milhões de irlandeses que emigraram pelo mundo.
entries.en_excerpt: An award-winning interactive museum telling the story of the 10 million Irish who emigrated around the world.

entries.title: National Museum of Ireland – Archaeology
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu nacional com tesouros da Irlanda antiga: artefatos vikings, ouro da Idade do Bronze e corpos de pântano.
entries.en_excerpt: The national museum with treasures of ancient Ireland: Viking artefacts, Bronze Age gold and bog bodies.

entries.title: Inch Beach
entries.pt_excerpt: Longa praia de areia na península de Dingle, popular para surf e caminhadas.
entries.en_excerpt: A long sandy beach on the Dingle Peninsula, popular for surfing and walks.

entries.title: Dingle Peninsula
entries.pt_excerpt: Península gaélica com praias selvagens, Slea Head e o centro urbano de Dingle.
entries.en_excerpt: A Gaelic-speaking peninsula with wild beaches, Slea Head and the town of Dingle.

entries.title: Ring of Kerry
entries.pt_excerpt: Rota cênica circular de 179 km pela península de Iveragh, com vistas costeiras espetaculares.
entries.en_excerpt: A 179 km scenic circular route around the Iveragh Peninsula, with spectacular coastal views.

entries.title: Gap of Dunloe
entries.pt_excerpt: Desfiladeiro glaciar entre montanhas, percorrido por carruagens e trilhas.
entries.en_excerpt: A glacial gorge between mountains, explored by horse-drawn carriages and on foot.

entries.title: Torc Waterfall
entries.pt_excerpt: Cascata de 20 metros rodeada de floresta, nas encostas do Monte Torc.
entries.en_excerpt: A 20-metre waterfall surrounded by woodland, on the slopes of Mount Torc.

entries.title: Ross Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo do século XV às margens do Lago de Leane, com passeios de barco.
entries.en_excerpt: A 15th-century castle on the shores of Lough Leane, with boat trips.

entries.title: Muckross House
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão vitoriana no coração do parque, com jardins e quintas tradicionais.
entries.en_excerpt: A Victorian mansion in the heart of the park, with gardens and traditional farms.

entries.title: Killarney National Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Primeiro parque nacional da Irlanda, com lagos, montanhas e o castelo de Ross.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's first national park, with lakes, mountains and Ross Castle.

entries.title: Mizen Head
entries.pt_excerpt: Ponto mais a sudoeste da Irlanda, com ponte sobre o desfiladeiro, sinal marítimo e vistas do Atlântico.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's most south-westerly point, with a bridge over the gorge, a maritime signal station and Atlantic views.

entries.title: Charles Fort
entries.pt_excerpt: Forte em estrela do século XVII na entrada do porto de Kinsale.
entries.en_excerpt: A 17th-century star fort at the entrance to Kinsale harbour.

entries.title: Kinsale
entries.pt_excerpt: Vila costeira pitoresca com ruas coloridas, gastronomia premiada e uma história marítima rica.
entries.en_excerpt: A picturesque coastal town with colourful streets, award-winning food and a rich maritime history.

entries.title: Jameson Distillery Midleton
entries.pt_excerpt: Destilaria histórica onde se produz o whisky Jameson, com visitas guiadas e degustações.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic distillery where Jameson whiskey is produced, with guided tours and tastings.

entries.title: Fota Wildlife Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque de vida selvagem na ilha de Fota, com animais em recintos abertos e um castelo.
entries.en_excerpt: A wildlife park on Fota Island, with animals in open enclosures and a castle.

entries.title: Titanic Experience Cobh
entries.pt_excerpt: Museu interativo que recria a história do Titanic e da sua ligação com Cobh.
entries.en_excerpt: An interactive museum recreating the story of the Titanic and its link with Cobh.

entries.title: Cobh
entries.pt_excerpt: Cidade portuária histórica, última paragem do Titanic e porto de partida de milhões de emigrantes.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic port town, the Titanic's last port of call and the departure point of millions of emigrants.

entries.title: Blarney Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo medieval famoso pela Pedra de Blarney, cujo beijo concede "o dom da eloquência".
entries.en_excerpt: A medieval castle famous for the Blarney Stone, whose kiss grants "the gift of eloquence".

entries.title: Kilkee Cliffs
entries.pt_excerpt: Passarela costeira ao longo de falésias com formações rochosas características.
entries.en_excerpt: A coastal walkway along cliffs with distinctive rock formations.

entries.title: Lahinch Beach
entries.pt_excerpt: Praia de areia popular para surf e banhos de mar na costa oeste da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A sandy beach popular for surfing and sea swimming on Ireland's west coast.

entries.title: Loop Head
entries.pt_excerpt: Península com falésias e um farol clássico na entrada do estuário do Shannon.
entries.en_excerpt: A peninsula with cliffs and a classic lighthouse at the mouth of the Shannon estuary.

entries.title: Doolin Cave
entries.pt_excerpt: Caverna com um dos maiores estalactites pendentes do mundo.
entries.en_excerpt: A cave with one of the largest free-hanging stalactites in the world.

entries.title: Aillwee Caves
entries.pt_excerpt: Sistema de cavernas no Burren com formações de pedra e uma cascata subterrânea.
entries.en_excerpt: A cave system in the Burren with stone formations and an underground waterfall.

entries.title: Bunratty Castle & Folk Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo do século XV restaurado com um parque folclórico que recria a vida rural irlandesa.
entries.en_excerpt: A restored 15th-century castle with a folk park recreating rural Irish life.

entries.title: Burren National Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Paisagem cárstica única de calcário com flora rara e trilhas no Condado de Clare.
entries.en_excerpt: A unique limestone karst landscape with rare flora and trails in County Clare.

entries.title: Cliffs of Moher
entries.pt_excerpt: Falésias de 214 metros sobre o Oceano Atlântico, uma das atrações naturais mais famosas da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: Cliffs 214 metres above the Atlantic Ocean, one of Ireland's most famous natural attractions.

entries.title: Galway Atlantaquaria
entries.pt_excerpt: Aquário nacional da Irlanda, em Salthill, com vida marinha local e tanques interativos.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's national aquarium, in Salthill, with local marine life and interactive tanks.

entries.title: Diamond Hill
entries.pt_excerpt: Trilha em Connemara com vistas panorâmicas da baía de Ballynakill e das Twelve Bens.
entries.en_excerpt: A trail in Connemara with panoramic views of Ballynakill Bay and the Twelve Bens.

entries.title: Dún Aonghasa
entries.pt_excerpt: Forte de pedra pré-histórico na borda de um penhasco de 100 m na ilha de Inishmore.
entries.en_excerpt: A prehistoric stone fort on the edge of a 100 m cliff on the island of Inishmore.

entries.title: Aran Islands
entries.pt_excerpt: Ilhas gaélicas na foz da Baía de Galway, famosas pelas fortalezas de pedra e cultura tradicional.
entries.en_excerpt: Gaelic islands at the mouth of Galway Bay, famous for their stone forts and traditional culture.

entries.title: Sky Road
entries.pt_excerpt: Rota costeira cênica ao redor da península de Kingstown, com vistas de Clifden e da baía.
entries.en_excerpt: A scenic coastal route around the Kingstown peninsula, with views of Clifden and the bay.

entries.title: Salthill
entries.pt_excerpt: Promenade litorânea de Galway, com praia, piscina de mar e vista para a baía.
entries.en_excerpt: Galway's seaside promenade, with a beach, a sea pool and views over the bay.

entries.title: Connemara National Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque nacional de montanhas, turfeiras e pôneis selvagens, com trilhas até o Diamond Hill.
entries.en_excerpt: A national park of mountains, bogs and wild ponies, with trails up Diamond Hill.

entries.title: Kylemore Abbey
entries.pt_excerpt: Mosteiro e castelo do século XIX num cenário lacustre deslumbrante em Connemara.
entries.en_excerpt: A 19th-century abbey and castle in a stunning lakeside setting in Connemara.

entries.title: Battle of the Boyne Visitor Centre
entries.pt_excerpt: Centro de visitantes que conta a história da Batalha do Boyne de 1690, na casa de Oldbridge.
entries.en_excerpt: A visitor centre telling the story of the 1690 Battle of the Boyne, at Oldbridge House.

entries.title: Loughcrew
entries.pt_excerpt: Conjunto de túmulos de passagem neolíticos nas colinas de Loughcrew, com arte rupestre.
entries.en_excerpt: A cluster of Neolithic passage tombs in the Loughcrew hills, with rock art.

entries.title: Slane Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo histórico às margens do rio Boyne, conhecido pelos seus concertos e destilaria.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic castle on the banks of the River Boyne, known for its concerts and distillery.

entries.title: Trim Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: O maior castelo anglo-normando da Irlanda, famoso por ter sido locação do filme "Braveheart".
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's largest Anglo-Norman castle, famous as a filming location for "Braveheart".

entries.title: Hill of Tara
entries.pt_excerpt: Antiga sede dos Reis Supremos da Irlanda, com monumentos e vistas panorâmicas.
entries.en_excerpt: The ancient seat of the High Kings of Ireland, with monuments and panoramic views.

entries.title: Knowth
entries.pt_excerpt: Grande túmulo de passagem neolítico com a maior coleção de arte megalítica da Europa ocidental.
entries.en_excerpt: A great Neolithic passage tomb with the largest collection of megalithic art in western Europe.

entries.title: Newgrange
entries.pt_excerpt: Túmulo de passagem neolítico com mais de 5.000 anos, mais antigo que Stonehenge e as pirâmides.
entries.en_excerpt: A Neolithic passage tomb over 5,000 years old, older than Stonehenge and the pyramids.

entries.title: Avondale Forest Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque florestal com trilhas, passeios de copa de árvores e história ligada a Charles Stewart Parnell.
entries.en_excerpt: A forest park with trails, treetop walks and history linked to Charles Stewart Parnell.

entries.title: Sally Gap
entries.pt_excerpt: Passo de montanha cênico nas montanhas de Wicklow, rodeado de turfeiras e berços dos rios Liffey e Dargle.
entries.en_excerpt: A scenic mountain pass in the Wicklow Mountains, surrounded by bogs where the rivers Liffey and Dargle rise.

entries.title: Great Sugar Loaf
entries.pt_excerpt: Pico de montanha em forma de cúpula com vistas panorâmicas das montanhas de Wicklow e da costa.
entries.en_excerpt: A dome-shaped mountain peak with panoramic views of the Wicklow Mountains and the coast.

entries.title: Bray Head
entries.pt_excerpt: Trilha costeira com uma grande cruz no topo e vistas da baía de Bray e das montanhas de Wicklow.
entries.en_excerpt: A coastal trail with a large cross at the summit and views of Bray Bay and the Wicklow Mountains.

entries.title: Powerscourt Waterfall
entries.pt_excerpt: A cachoeira mais alta da Irlanda, com 121 metros, cercada por trilhas na floresta.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's highest waterfall, at 121 metres, surrounded by forest trails.

entries.title: Powerscourt Estate
entries.pt_excerpt: Mansão histórica com jardins premiados e o Terraço da Cachoeira; também há um centro de compras e café.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic mansion with award-winning gardens and the Waterfall Terrace; there is also a shopping centre and café.

entries.title: Glendalough
entries.pt_excerpt: Assentamento monástico do século VI num vale glacial com lagos e trilhas.
entries.en_excerpt: A 6th-century monastic settlement in a glacial valley with lakes and trails.

entries.title: Wicklow Mountains National Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Parque nacional de montanhas, lagos e vales glaciais, conhecido como o "Jardim da Irlanda".
entries.en_excerpt: A national park of mountains, lakes and glacial valleys — known as the "Garden of Ireland".

entries.title: Malahide Castle & Gardens
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo de 800 anos com jardins exuberantes, localizado na vila litorânea de Malahide.
entries.en_excerpt: An 800-year-old castle with lush gardens, located in the coastal village of Malahide.

entries.title: Howth Cliff Walk
entries.pt_excerpt: Trilha costeira espetacular ao redor da península de Howth, com vistas do mar da Irlanda.
entries.en_excerpt: A spectacular coastal trail around the Howth Peninsula, with views of the Irish Sea.

entries.title: Dublin Zoo
entries.pt_excerpt: Zoológico no Phoenix Park com animais de todo o mundo e programas de conservação.
entries.en_excerpt: A zoo in Phoenix Park with animals from around the world and conservation programmes.

entries.title: Phoenix Park
entries.pt_excerpt: Um dos maiores parques urbanos fechados da Europa, lar de veados selvagens, a residência presidencial e o Dublin Zoo.
entries.en_excerpt: One of Europe's largest enclosed city parks, home to wild deer, the presidential residence and Dublin Zoo.

entries.title: Guinness Storehouse
entries.pt_excerpt: A famosa fábrica e museu da cerveja Guinness, com o bar panorâmico Gravity no topo.
entries.en_excerpt: The famous Guinness brewery and museum, with the panoramic Gravity Bar at the top.

entries.title: Kilmainham Gaol
entries.pt_excerpt: Prisão histórica que desempenhou papel central na luta pela independência irlandesa. Museu imperdível.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic prison that played a central role in the struggle for Irish independence. An unmissable museum.

entries.title: Dublin Castle
entries.pt_excerpt: Castelo histórico no coração de Dublin, sede do governo britânico na Irlanda por séculos e agora um complexo de museus e salões de estado.
entries.en_excerpt: A historic castle in the heart of Dublin, seat of the British government in Ireland for centuries and now a complex of museums and state halls.

entries.title: Trinity College & Book of Kells
entries.pt_excerpt: A icônica universidade irlandesa e o famoso Livro de Kells, um dos mais importantes manuscritos medievais do mundo.
entries.en_excerpt: Ireland's iconic university and the famous Book of Kells, one of the most important medieval manuscripts in the world.
